entries.task_id: is applied|to|individual layers
entries.description: is applied to individual layers
entries.subject: is applied

spans.text: Batch normalization is applied to individual layers, or optionally, to all of them: In each training iteration, we first normalize the inputs (of batch normalization) by subtracting their mean and dividing by their standard deviation, where both are estimated based on the statistics of the current minibatch.
